Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Can't accept invite — portal stuck in 'Preview' (PO missing)

Hi Sofia,

We received the supplier invite and completed the acceptance flow, but the portal still shows a "Preview account" message and none of the POs are visible. The PO that triggered the onboarding (PO-12345) is not listed and the "Accept PO" button is disabled.

I tried:
- clicking the activation link twice (no redirect)
- opening in Chrome on Windows and Safari on macOS
- forwarding the invite to our ops alias (ops@laminar-supplies.com)

Attached is a screenshot of the dashboard state (screenshot-preview.png). Any idea what the preview state means and how we can get the PO to appear? We need the PO visible to start fulfillment.

Thanks,
Elena Morales

Subject: Re: Can't accept invite — portal stuck in 'Preview' (PO missing)

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the screenshot, and sorry for the friction.

Quick context: "Preview" is an onboarding state we show when the supplier profile has not completed a required verification step (bank details or KYC flag) — it should not block PO visibility but in some account states the UI mistakenly suppresses PO tiles. We're investigating.

Can you do two quick checks so we can narrow this down:
1) Try an incognito/private window (this rules out cached session cookies).
2) If you still see Preview, reply with the last 8 characters of the acceptance token (the link you clicked) or paste the entire acceptance URL — that helps us correlate the invite record.

I attached a short diagnostic checklist that has the exact steps and where to find the token: diagnostic-instructions.pdf. If possible include the acceptance URL and the browser + OS you tested.

I'll loop in Ben and Monica on the ops side to look at the invite record as soon as you send the token.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Partner Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@laminar-supplies.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Can't accept invite — portal stuck in 'Preview' (PO missing)

Thanks for the details, Elena — the token helps.

Root cause hypothesis (based on similar incidents): when a supplier profile was partially created via a marketplace import, the account ends up with an intermediate "preview" flag set and a missing "po_visibility" property. That combination hides PO tiles even after a successful acceptance.

Plan:
- I'll correlate the acceptance token (9f7b2c4e) with our invite table (INVITES) and check the supplier record (vendor_id).
- If vendor_id exists but po_visibility=false, we can flip that flag for this vendor as a manual remediation and re-trigger a dashboard refresh. This is low-risk and reversible.

Sofia / Monica — can you confirm we have approval to do a one-off manual activation for Laminar (vendor lookup using the token)? If yes I will escalate to ops with the ticket OPS-2371 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-2371) and request the flag flip + cache invalidation.

Ben
Senior Site Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@laminar-supplies.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Can't accept invite — portal stuck in 'Preview' (PO missing)

Hi Elena — quick update.

We completed a manual activation for your vendor record (used the acceptance token you provided to find vendor_id and flipped the po_visibility flag). We also invalidated the server-side cache for your tenant and reissued a fresh session.

Can you reload the portal (Ctrl+F5) and confirm you now see PO-12345? I attached a copy of the PO we pulled for verification (PO-12345.pdf).

If everything looks OK we'll close this ticket; if not, please paste any console errors or the UI state and we'll keep investigating.

Apologies for the extra steps — I'll loop in our platform team to add a guard so future marketplace-imported accounts don't end up in this intermediate state.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Engineer | Redwood Inference
